title: Truth Bangle (DS)

The '''Truth Bangle''' is found in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]].''

Wearing it (by putting it on the blue square of the touch screen) will make the Top Screen have a small yellow box appear of the bottom-right corner. (of the Top Screen)

The box looks like this when you wake up:

Stamina 100/100
Fatigue 0/100

[[Stamina|Stamina Points]] show if the player is still refreshed and not tired. Fatigue Points show if the player is tired or not.

Your character will faint when the box shows this:

Stamina 0/100
Fatigue 100/100

It is important to see if your character is healthy. Sometimes, when you faint, you even lose money!

The Truth Bangle can help you with that. It can be found in the [[Sprite Casino (DS)|Sprite Casino]] after getting Medals.
